mapper.select: select s.student_id as studentId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.student_name as studentName, s.gender as gender, s.birth_date as birthDate, s.enrollment_year as enrollmentYear, s.education_level as educationLevel, s.student_status as studentStatus, s.user_id as userId, d.dept_name as deptName, m.major_name as majorName, c.class_name as className from sam_student s left join brm_department d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id left join brm_major m on s.major_id = m.major_id left join brm_class c on s.class_id = c.class_id where s.student_id = #{studentId} limit 1

select (select count(distinct gr.course_id) from aem_grade_record gr where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.status = '0') as courseCount, coalesce((select sum(cl.credit) from aem_grade_record gr join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = gr.course_id where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.is_pass = '1' and gr.status = '0'), 0) as earnedCredit, coalesce((select sum(cl.credit) from aem_grade_record gr join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = gr.course_id where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.status = '0'), 0) as attemptedCredit, (select round(sum(gr.grade_point * cl.credit) / sum(cl.credit), 2) from aem_grade_record gr join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = gr.course_id where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.status = '0' and gr.grade_point is not null) as gpa, (select round(sum(gr.total_score * cl.credit) / sum(cl.credit), 2) from aem_grade_record gr join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = gr.course_id where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.status = '0' and gr.total_score is not null) as avgScore, coalesce((select count(distinct gr.course_id) from aem_grade_record gr where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.is_pass = '0' and gr.status = '0'), 0) as failCount from (select 1) t

select tp.plan_id as planId, tp.plan_name as planName, tp.plan_year as planYear, tp.version as version, tp.total_credits as totalCredits from sam_student st join tpm_training_plan tp on tp.major_id = st.major_id and tp.del_flag = '0' and tp.publish_status = '1' and (tp.plan_year = st.enrollment_year or st.enrollment_year is null or tp.plan_year is null) where st.student_id = #{studentId} order by tp.plan_year desc, tp.plan_id desc limit 1

select cs.credit_type as creditType, cs.credit_type_name as creditTypeName, cs.required_credit as requiredCredit from tpm_credit_structure cs where cs.plan_id = #{planId} and cs.del_flag = '0' order by cs.struct_id

select cl.course_category as creditType, coalesce(sum(cl.credit), 0) as earnedCredit from aem_grade_record gr join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = gr.course_id where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.is_pass = '1' and gr.status = '0' and cl.course_category is not null group by cl.course_category

select warning_type as warningType, warning_level as warningLevel, warning_reason as warningReason, warning_date as warningDate, is_resolved as isResolved from sam_warning where student_id = #{studentId} and status = '0' order by warning_date desc

select 'graduation' as reviewType, review_status as reviewStatus, review_date as reviewDate, reviewer as reviewer from sam_graduation_review where student_id = #{studentId} and status = '0' union all select 'degree' as reviewType, review_status as reviewStatus, review_date as reviewDate, reviewer as reviewer from sam_degree_review where student_id = #{studentId} and status = '0'

select plan_year as planYear, topic_name as topicName, current_stage as currentStage, stage_status as stageStatus, total_score as totalScore, grade_level as gradeLevel, is_qualified as isQualified from sam_thesis where student_id = #{studentId} and status = '0' order by thesis_id desc limit 1

select cl.course_name as courseName, gr.credit as credit, gr.total_score as totalScore, gr.grade_point as gradePoint, gr.is_pass as isPass, gr.semester_id as semesterId from aem_grade_record gr left join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = gr.course_id where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.status = '0' order by gr.create_time desc, gr.course_id asc limit #{limit}
